articles.title: E20 debate widens: Karnataka to reveal probe findings on Monday; MoS Suresh Gopi backs OMCs
articles.description: Karnataka authorities are set to reveal more information regarding the alleged excessive ethanol blending in petrol. Chief Minister DK Shivakumar stated that the government has received numerous complaints from motorists concerning vehicle performance issues. Inspection teams collected petrol samples from various retail fuel outlets and ethanol blending facilities across the state. Additionally, Kerala has ordered laboratory tests on petrol samples amid this controversy.

articles.title: Indian stock market pauses after seven-day rally as Sensex, Nifty end Diwali session lower
articles.description: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower during the special Muhurat Trading session on Diwali, taking a breather after a more than 10 per cent rally over seven sessions, supported by strong foreign investor inflows, falling crude oil prices and upbeat corporate earnings.
